'''Clan Ryo''', also known as the '''Ryo syndicate''', was an ancient aristocratic [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] family from [[Shikaakwa]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]], a family whose leader bore the title of [[Clan Ryo Baron|Baron]] as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. Many members of the Clan were [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]]. Any potential ties between the Clan and the Twi'lek homeworld of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] remain unknown.
